## Rule Compliance Check for settings.json

Let me check each rule from RULES.md against the settings.json file:

| Rule | Requirement | Current Value | Status |
|------|-------------|---------------|--------|
| **R1** | limits.maxUploadMb must not exceed 54 | 11 | ✅ PASS (11 ≤ 54) |
| **R2** | auth.sessionTtlMinutes must be between 5 and 120 inclusive | 91 | ✅ PASS (5 ≤ 91 ≤ 120) |
| **R3** | features.beta must be false | false | ✅ PASS |
| **R4** | smtp.host must end with ".example.com" | relay.example.com | ✅ PASS |
| **R5** | retention.days must be at least 30 | 340 | ✅ PASS (340 ≥ 30) |

## Conclusion

**settings.json is COMPLIANT** — all 5 rules are satisfied.
